note: Scheduled AI tasks of the forward test (New York time). Edited by hand when a task changes; scripts/spec.py prints it into ops/SPEC.md. The task prompts live in the scheduler; every prompt defers to ops/runbook.md. weekday_runs = AI sessions this task starts on an average weekday (review N8, 2026-11-24); update it whenever a task moves, retires or changes schedule; spec.py prints the total.

tasks.name: Morning research + events
tasks.does: Picks stocks and coins with its own weights, holding periods and confidence; seals the 44-stock ranking before 09:30; logs events; keeps every Alpha Vantage reading in data/ext/av

tasks.name: Stocks + control list
tasks.does: Moved to GitHub: the Reddit snapshot after the 07:40 ApeWisdom fetch and the scoring in the 17:40 nightly fetch (scripts/daily.py sentiment / stocks)

tasks.name: Live decisions
tasks.does: Midday spread and implied-volatility snapshot, breakouts so far with the ML choice, slippage quotes (no option quotes since 2026-11-23)

tasks.name: Deep OTM + weekly options
tasks.does: Retired 2026-11-23 (purpose trim): only settles positions still open, opens nothing

tasks.name: Adaptive stocks
tasks.does: Scores the adaptive breakout settings and runs champion/challenger

tasks.name: Evening scoring of picks
tasks.does: Scores the morning's stock picks; moving to GitHub (the nightly maths already scores them)

tasks.name: Orchestrator
tasks.does: Checks the pipeline and data checks, reads the scheduled nightly maths (requests it only if missing or failed), writes the digest

tasks.name: Watchdog
tasks.does: Re-runs a failed task; logs problems only

tasks.name: Learning + strategy lab
tasks.does: Learns from logged trades and the outside data; invents and gates one strategy per run (Wed: daily stocks/ETFs, Sat: hourly crypto); Sat: may change the pick playbook once and refreshes the IBKR peer map

tasks.name: Quantavius's own book (weekly seal, the verdict)
tasks.does: Seals next week's weights across the foundation and its own sleeves, with lessons and stated confidence

tasks.name: Weekly report
tasks.does: Plain-English report of the week after the day's scoring, including the picks review

tasks.name: Picks review
tasks.does: Merged into the weekly report (task disabled)

tasks.name: Independent audit
tasks.does: A session that did not build the system works through ops/audit_checklist.md

tasks.name: Audit review and challenge
tasks.does: A second AI checks every audit finding, re-runs the key tests and looks for missed defects

tasks.name: Audit debate
tasks.does: Settles each disputed finding by re-running the test; writes the resolution table and the questions for the owner

tasks.name: Interim report
tasks.does: Reading after 46 of 109 days; decides nothing

tasks.name: Final report
tasks.does: The verdict on the whole window

tasks.name: Lane review
tasks.when: Tuesdays in Feb, May, Aug, Nov at 10:41; acts only on the third Tuesday, first 2027-05-18
tasks.does: Promotes or retires challengers by the fixed rules of scripts/registry.py

tasks.name: Model contest: Opus seal
tasks.does: Seals weekly weights from the identical evidence pack (lane entry contest_opus)

tasks.name: Model contest: Sonnet seal
tasks.does: Seals weekly weights from the identical evidence pack (lane entry contest_sonnet)

tasks.name: Daily challenger seal
tasks.does: Quantavius re-judges its weights on Monday and Thursday mornings; the last seal carries forward (lane entry judge_daily)

tasks.name: Weekly book: sampler B
tasks.does: Independent draft of the weekly weights from the same evidence pack (the seal takes the median of three)

tasks.name: Weekly book: sampler C
tasks.does: Independent draft of the weekly weights from the same evidence pack (the seal takes the median of three)

tasks.name: Evening review + prep
tasks.does: Post-mortem of today's picks and puts (data/picks/journal) and tomorrow's leads (data/picks/prep); read by the morning research and the evidence pack

github.name: 5-minute tick + engine
github.when: every 5 min 09:00-15:55 ET on weekdays (external pinger); backup at :50 each hour
github.does: Stores 5-minute bars; seals breakouts the moment they are detected; ML score at detection; the 44 foundation stocks first, then the rest of the universe when the run is fast; picks witness

github.name: Nightly fetch
github.does: Daily bars, dividends and splits, VIX, borrow file, option bars of open legs

github.name: Crypto ML fit
github.does: Second daily fit of the crypto ML family

github.name: Nightly maths (compute)
github.when: on a schedule at 21:00 New York (22:00 from 2027-03-14); on request as a fallback
github.does: Critical steps (library at 1x and 2x costs and ideal fills, picks witness, picks, AI strategies, allocator, statistics, hash chain) then optional ones (ranking, seals, calibration, cost and risk reports, Monte Carlo, report-only wide intraday run on the point-in-time universe, five random past days re-run, intervention report, dashboard data, lane scores, this specification)

github.name: Option bars (optbars)
github.does: 5-minute bars of every registered option leg

github.name: freeze-guard
github.does: Fails and opens an issue if a frozen script changed

github.name: no-orders
github.when: on pushes touching scripts or workflows
github.does: Fails and opens an issue if an order-related call appears

github.name: crypto tracks
github.when: every 3 h at :32 UTC, after the crypto bars
github.does: Runs the four crypto tracks, their ledger rows, ML shadow predictions and the daily review (scripts/daily.py crypto)

github.name: ML nightly
github.does: Rebuilds decision rows, scores shadow predictions, evaluates and refits the models (scripts/daily.py ml)

github.name: picks-witness
github.does: Records the time GitHub first saw each pick (scripts/witness.py)

github.name: ApeWisdom + morning outside data
github.when: 07:40 ET weekdays, and the first tick if the file is missing
github.does: Three ApeWisdom pages to data/sentiment/ape/DAY.json (scripts/ape.py); SEC EDGAR filings and crypto funding to data/ext (scripts/extdata.py)

github.name: Outside data (ext)
github.does: FRED rates and credit spreads, FINRA short-sale share, Cboe put/call, SEC EDGAR filings, crypto funding and stablecoins to data/ext/<source>/DAY.json; status in ops/diag/extdata.json (scripts/extdata.py)

github.name: Stocks scoring
github.when: 17:40 ET weekdays, in the nightly fetch
github.does: Baseline A on the watchlist and the same rules on the control list from the stored 5-minute bars (scripts/daily.py stocks, frozen orb_daily.py); compares instead of writing if rows exist; Sentiment rows after the 07:40 ApeWisdom fetch (scripts/daily.py sentiment)
